laplog_toggle_ui_mini.title: LapLog: Toggle mini panel
laplog_toggle_ui_mini.desc: Collapse the LapLog HUD app to its mini badge, or expand it back
laplog_toggle_ui_mini.onDown: if extensions and extensions.laplog and extensions.laplog.hotkeyToggleMinimize then extensions.laplog.hotkeyToggleMinimize() end
